name: sk-login
description: Sign in with Secret Keeper: protocol core, NestJS module and browser widget

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/nestjs -w packages/widget
scripts.check: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/nestjs/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/widget/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run
